forward_chaining.notes: Matches rule premises against fact database, applies substitutions to derive conclusions

rule_matching.notes: Handles uppercase variables, ground constants, and negative premises (ncoll, diff, nperp, npara)

fact_normalization.notes: Normalizes cong, eqangle, eqratio, perp, para, coll, cyclic

gnn_state_encoding.description: Graph Neural Network encoding of geometric proof states
gnn_state_encoding.notes: Nodes are points, edges are geometric relations; edge features encode predicate types

neural_guidance.description: GNN value function estimates proximity to goal
neural_guidance.notes: Trained on synthetic proof walks with MSE loss; used as heuristic in best-first search

search_strategies.notes: BFS, Beam search, Heuristic BFS, Neural-guided BFS, Neural-guided Beam
